Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Added Progress-managed Lotto payouts. Porter recognizes listed lottery winners, transfers exact installments of up to 1,000,000 gil per completed trade, records each installment safely, marks the row PAID only after the full total, and sends the existing Discord reward notification when payment is complete.
